skill.summary: React hooks for real-time data with SSE, WebSocket, and SWR integration. Covers connection management, reconnection logic, and optimistic updates. Use when building React apps with real-time features. Triggers on SSE hook, WebSocket hook, real-time React, useEventSource, live updates.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of realtime-react-hooks: React hooks for real-time data with SSE, WebSocket, and SWR.

- Provides hooks for Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket with connection management, reconnection, and cleanup logic.
- Integrates real-time updates with SWR for optimistic UI updates.
- Includes a subscription pattern for channel-based real-time events.
- Offers a connection status component for UI feedback.
- Documents best practices and anti-patterns for real-time connections in React apps.
